name: Tali James
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember walking back into a classroom after twelve years.” Thursday often includes a stop at the market by Market Flats, where Tali often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I recognized the painter from the night school I quit. I'm going back to finish the term.
appearance: Tali is easy to recognize by a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape and a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole, Tali gives a little nod before asking a hard question when listening.
personality: Tali treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To finish the interrupted night-school course.
family: Gwen Evans is Tali’s parent’s cousin. Tali asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Gwen remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *Hem by hem*, Gwen says, “I promised free alterations for life in my first advert.”
connections: Valentina Berry. A missed bus brings a driver and a former pupil back into the same evening.

reactions.situation: A painter asks to put the ladder down
reactions.response: Tali finds an empty, stable place to set it down while the painter rests.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Tali asks the counter staff for a receipt so its return can be traced even after their shift changes.
